audit_items.proof_trace: All oracle price consumers call one of get_price, get_spot_price, or get_price_with_check (user.move:26-59), each of which invokes check_price (user.move:61-69) enforcing age <= price_delay_tolerance_ms — so the staleness assumption is universally satisfied. The EMA/spot deviation guard (get_price_with_check) is applied in both debts_value_usd_non_liquidation and collaterals_usd_non_liquidation for borrow/withdraw safety checks; its deliberate omission in the liquidation path (which uses EMA via get_price, the harder-to-manipulate price) is an intentional design choice to ensure liquidations proceed during market stress. At Pyth refresh time (pyth_adaptor.move:60,91-95) a confidence-interval tolerance check also bounds acceptable price uncertainty for both EMA and spot feeds.
